description: Adora discovers the Sword of Protection, leaves the Horde and joins Glimmer and Bow, learning what She-Ra means while the new Princess Alliance begins resisting Catra and the forces she once served.

s01e01.description: Sneaking away after a Horde training mission, Adora discovers a mysterious sword in the Whispering Woods while Glimmer searches for help for the Rebellion.

s01e02.description: Adora, Glimmer and Bow flee a monster into a First Ones ruin while Shadow Weaver orders Catra to bring Adora back to the Horde.

s01e03.description: Adora's first attempt to reach Bright Moon goes badly and sends her into the woods, where the eccentric Madame Razz helps her understand what she has become.

s01e04.description: Adora joins a relief mission to besieged Plumeria and learns that becoming She-Ra does not automatically solve the problems the Horde leaves behind.

s01e05.description: The new squad travels to Salineas to recruit Mermista, but first needs a ship while Catra and Scorpia take to the sea from the other side.

s01e06.description: Entrapta's corrupted robots infect She-Ra with the same First Ones virus, turning a recruitment trip to Dryl into a technological emergency.

s01e07.description: A visit to the magical sanctuary of Mystacor is meant to calm Adora, but Shadow Weaver reaches into the very fears she is trying to escape.

s01e08.description: At Princess Frosta's diplomatic prom, Adora tries to recruit a new ally while Catra and other unexpected guests turn the celebration into a strategic contest.

s01e09.description: With friends imprisoned in the Fright Zone, Adora convinces the Princess Alliance to attempt a dangerous rescue inside Horde territory.

s01e10.description: The Princess Alliance begins to fracture as Adora searches for answers about her training and Glimmer hides the worsening instability of her powers.

s01e11.description: Adora and Catra are trapped together inside a First Ones simulation that forces both of them through painful memories of growing up under Shadow Weaver.

s01e12.description: Light Hope reveals more of She-Ra's history and Etheria's First Ones legacy while Entrapta deciphers technology that may change the balance of the war.

s01e13.description: Catra and Scorpia exploit weakened runestones to attack Bright Moon, forcing the princesses to defend the heart of the Rebellion.
